acceptanceCriteria: Blog post created at site/src/data/blog/getting-around-jb.ts with frontmatter (title, date, slug, excerpt, content)

Post appears in blog index at /blog with correct metadata and links

stories.title: Implement JB News & Updates RSS Widget on Homepage
stories.description: Create a dynamic widget that fetches from curated JB tourism and local news RSS feeds and displays latest 3-5 items on the homepage hero section to support goal #4 (JB News & Updates widget).
acceptanceCriteria: JBNewsWidget component fetches from at least 3 RSS sources (e.g., Tourism Johor, JB Today, Visit JB) with 60-minute cache TTL
Widget displays latest 3-5 news items with title, excerpt, link, and publish date; updates without page reload
Error handling: if feed fetch fails, widget shows graceful fallback message ('News temporarily unavailable') instead of breaking page

stories.title: Dynamically Add All Blog Post URLs to XML Sitemap
stories.description: Modify sitemap.ts to auto-discover all blog posts from site/src/data/blog/ and include them with correct metadata in /sitemap.xml output to support goal #6 (update sitemap with blog posts).
acceptanceCriteria: sitemap.ts uses getAllBlogPosts() to discover all blog post files and map to sitemap entries
Each blog post generates a sitemap entry with loc=/blog/slug, lastmod=post.date, changefreq='weekly', priority=0.8
Generated /sitemap.xml validates as well-formed XML and includes all 6+ blog post URLs with correct hrefs

stories.title: Implement Zod Schema Validation for Blog Post Frontmatter
stories.description: Create a reusable Zod schema to validate blog post metadata (title, date, excerpt, slug, tags, image) at build time to catch errors early and support goal #1 (robust blog system foundation).
acceptanceCriteria: Zod schema (PostFrontmatterSchema) enforces required fields: title, slug, date, excerpt, and content with correct types
Optional fields (tags: string[], image?: string, author?: string) have sensible defaults; all properties are typed
Build fails with descriptive error message if any blog post file violates schema; valid posts build successfully

File to modify: site/src/lib/blog-posts.ts (apply schema.parse() or .safeParse() validation when loading blog posts in getAllBlogPosts())
Test command: npx vitest run site/tests/lib/blog-schema.test.ts && npm run build (verify validation executes at build time)
